gitnexus-hook.js.reason: Optional GitNexus integration; no default runtime registration is intended.

multi-agent-lock.sh.reason: Legacy environment-variable lock guard; agent-arbitration and current ownership controls replaced its default role.

permission-auto-approve.sh.reason: Available conservative PermissionRequest policy, intentionally not enabled by default because it changes approval behavior.

rtk-bridge.sh.reason: Explicit opt-in bridge to an external, non-vendored binary; its own contract forbids default registration. Superseded for most use by the native YANA_COMPACT=1 path (yana-rt compact, wired through sandbox-wrap.sh) — kept as a documented legacy alternative, not deleted.
